recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white cinematic scene featuring two subjects in formal attire, framed by a thin gold border, utilizing a mix of ultra-condensed serif display type and a casual, hand-drawn script accent.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast monochrome photography against a thin, warm-toned border frame.
Geometric, rigid display typography at the top vs. organic, fluid script at the bottom.
Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting defining the silhouettes and facial features of the subjects.
coreInvariants: Deep black shadows with bright white highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects occupy the mid-ground; one in profile facing left, one in three-quarter view facing right, creating a balanced but asymmetrical tension.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, condensed serif text at the top center acts as the primary anchor, balanced by the script in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text, follows the gaze of the male subject down to the female subject, and exits through the script at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of dark negative space in the background to isolate the subjects and provide a canvas for the top typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white photography for the main imagery.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale gold or cream for the border and primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pastel pink for the hand-drawn script element.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast in the photo; low saturation in the accent colors to maintain a vintage feel.

letterConstructionRules: Display type is extremely tall and narrow with high stroke contrast.
Script type is monolinear, mimicking a felt-tip marker with a slight tilt.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script includes a decorative underline stroke.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between rigid, architectural serifs and loose, personal handwriting.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and high contrast of the display type.
Captures the informal, signed feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of a man in a white suit and a woman in a patterned dress in a classic interior with a fluted column. Apply a thin gold border around the entire frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed bold serif text in gold at the top center. Add a casual, hand-drawn script in pastel pink with a black outline at the bottom right, tilted slightly upward.

verificationChecks: Is the top text extremely narrow and tall?
Does the script look like it was written with a marker?
Is the gold border thin and consistent?

adjustableVariables: Vertical stretch of the serif font
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold border does not overlap the subjects.
Check that the script text remains legible against the white suit.
Verify the vertical serif text is perfectly centered.
Confirm the black and white image has deep, true blacks.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W photo + Ultra-condensed Serif (Top) + Marker Script (Bottom Right) + Gold Frame = Retro Sophistication.
